physical: A body immersed in a fluid is pushed up by a force equal to the weight of the fluid it displaces; it floats if it is less dense than the fluid.
reflected_sentence: The equation keeps: Frequency is Desire times Vibrance times a downward pull, and floating follows the lesser Desire.
rule_reason: Equation with an empty cost block: no listed resistance-cost and no listed separation, so the relationship keeps.
interpretation: No cost is in the block, so the relationship keeps. Frequency, Desire, and Vibrance are frozen partners. The downward pull has no frozen partner, so no formula is written.
closing: The empty cost block and the equation form keep the relationship. The float clause compares densities and was not added as an unlisted limit. Gravitational field g has no partner; Appreciation and Attraction were not used for it. No new word was introduced.
